selection_baseline.matching_rule: Credit at most one reference finding when the final roster preserves the same proposition, population, metric, period/status, and material scope. A shared topic, source page, or related commercial theme is not equivalent.

reference_findings.source_quote: Three-quarters of respondents (75%) see these changes as having a large or very large impact on publishers over the next three years. Very large impact 15%; large impact 60%. Base = 265.

metric.subject: impact on publishers from AI browsers and agentic apps

reference_findings.commercial_importance: High: publisher discovery and access may be affected by AI-browser and agentic interfaces.
reference_findings.observed_disposition: Source-supported candidate was present in the retained inventory but was not in the selected candidate roster; the persisted artifact has no selector-level rejection reason.
reference_findings.semantic_recall_note: The selected 43% search-traffic forecast is a related discovery risk, not the same publisher-impact proposition.

reference_findings.source_quote: These tools don't answer questions. They read documents, execute analysis, write deliverables and verify outputs against defined standards.
reference_findings.commercial_importance: High: the report's AI value proposition includes end-to-end execution and verification, not only analysis.
reference_findings.observed_disposition: The audit inventory contains a source-verified page-24 quote, but the retained evidence-fidelity ledger has no supported result for quote-2; selection eligibility cannot be inferred safely.
reference_findings.semantic_recall_note: The selected AI diligence and integration rows are adjacent capabilities, not the same production-and-verification proposition.

reference_findings.source_quote: In fact, US agencies estimate the cost of running campaigns across digital media channels will rise by 22% in 2023.

metric.subject: cost of running campaigns across digital media channels

reference_findings.commercial_importance: High: a quantified cost pressure is directly relevant to channel-budget planning.
reference_findings.observed_disposition: Supported candidate was in the retained inventory but was not in the selected candidate roster; it competed with incrementality and newer-channel ROI findings.
reference_findings.semantic_recall_note: The retained 50% incrementality and 61% perceived-ROI findings do not preserve the campaign-cost estimate.

reference_findings.source_quote: Twenty-three percent of consumers already use generative AI for product discovery while shopping, and of those who do, 35% are using it to speed up their shopping process.

metric.subject: use of generative AI to speed up shopping
metric.population: consumers who use generative AI for product discovery while shopping
metric.denominator: consumers who use generative AI for product discovery while shopping

reference_findings.commercial_importance: High: discovery-speed utility is a distinct consumer use case for AI-assisted shopping journeys.
reference_findings.observed_disposition: Supported candidate was in the retained inventory but was not in the selected candidate roster; it competed within the AI-shopping journey theme.
reference_findings.semantic_recall_note: The selected 24% default-plan and 64% intended-use findings describe adoption plans, not the 35% speed use among discovery users.

reference_findings.source_quote: After a positive resolution, 59% of total respondents bought from the brand again (62% U.S.; 57% U.K.).
reference_findings.commercial_importance: High: it connects service recovery with observed repeat buying, a direct retention outcome.
reference_findings.observed_disposition: Supported candidate was in the retained inventory but was not in the selected candidate roster; the roster retained service-response expectation instead.
reference_findings.semantic_recall_note: The selected 84% quick-response expectation is an input/service standard, not the post-resolution repeat-purchase outcome.

reference_findings.source_quote: With increased signal loss and the decline of cookies, 1st-party and contextual data become the core of durable retail marketing strategies. Together, they enable privacy-first targeting, personalization, and measurement across the retail journey.
reference_findings.commercial_importance: High: it identifies the data mechanism supporting targeting, personalization and measurement as signals decline.
reference_findings.observed_disposition: Supported candidate was in the retained inventory but was not in the selected candidate roster; the selected 68% relevance expectation covers only part of the mechanism.
reference_findings.semantic_recall_note: The selected 68% expectation and programmatic-capability rows are related but do not preserve the first-party/contextual foundation proposition.
